AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-14-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Valarie Papale
Petitioner: Yong Chang Xiao, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Yue Lik Benjamin Xiao, and with Cantonese Interperter: Kevin Guan, was swron and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Benjamin Yu Lik Xiao.
Decree signed in open court.
